regionsNote: Picked for this demo: AGSIST's ten states with the most engaged visits, Sep 29 to Oct 26, 2026.

fields.headline: Your ad here
fields.body: Shown only to readers in the states you pick, on the pages they use every week.

rateCard._: THE ONE DEFINITION OF WHAT A PLACEMENT COSTS (pricing panel, Oct 29, 2026). Read by sponsor.html, sponsor-apply.html, sponsor-kit.html, each sponsor's own portal and scripts/sponsor_apply.py. scripts/test_rate_card.py fails if a price or term here is not on sponsor.html. Prices are MONTHLY (price_month). A State Sponsor costs price_month in most states and price_by_state where listed; a state in opens_soon is shown but not taken yet (Oct 29, 2026: California, Nevada and Texas, held while the Root Lot test runs there; scripts/test_rate_card.py holds this list to every active entry in data/geo-sponsors.json). Change a price HERE first, then run scripts/stamp_rates.py and the prose around it.
rateCard.trial: First month free on every tier. No card, no commitment.
rateCard.day30: On day 30 you get a report and one email asking yes or no. No reply means the ad comes down and nothing is owed.
rateCard.terms: Month to month after that. No minimum, cancel any time, no penalty.
rateCard.prepay: Pay 12 months up front for the price of 10.

founding.text: Founding sponsor rate: the first 5 paying sponsors keep their price for 24 months.

rateCard.insurance: Farmers First never takes a sponsor slot, and AGSIST never sends readers to an agent.

tiers.name: Daily Sponsor
tiers.placement: Your card in every Daily briefing, on the web and in the email, plus a sponsor strip near the top of the homepage. One sponsor only.

tiers.name: State Sponsor
tiers.placement: One business per state: the state's cash bids page and every town page in it, the state's cash rent page, and a card shown to readers in that state.

tiers.name: Cash Bids Sponsor
tiers.placement: The sponsor ribbon on Cash Bids near me (agsist.com/cash-bids). One sponsor only.

tiers.name: Featured elevator
tiers.placement: An elevator's own logo, phone and a call to sell box on its own town page, labeled Sponsored. It never changes bid order or any bid.

retired._: Tier ids that older records may still carry. Not sold since Oct 29, 2026. A state's cash bids and cash rent ribbons are now the State Sponsor, /cash-bids is the Cash Bids Sponsor, and the other single page ribbons are not sold.
